papers.title_en: PathRIR: Physics-Guided Acoustic Path Selection and Late-Tail Compensation for Fast Room Impulse Response Simulation
papers.authors: Shaoheng Xu, Chunyi Sun, Jihui Zhang, Amy Bastine, Prasanga N. Samarasinghe, Thushara D. Abhayapala
papers.evidence: 物理引导的声学路径选择与补偿网络用于快速房间冲激响应模拟，有助于主动降噪的声学建模
papers.tldr: 基于镜像源法(ISM)的房间冲激响应(RIR)仿真虽具物理可解释性，但高阶和复杂房间下计算代价高。本文提出PathRIR物理引导框架，在在线遍历时仅保留声学重要的镜像源路径，并利用轻量补偿MLP预测缺失的晚期尾部能量包络来补偿截断能量。在非规则3D房间上，PathRIR减少镜像源计算、提升运行效率，同时保持低波形和衰减误差。消融表明补偿尾部改善波形保真度和多种声学指标，仅增加轻微开销。
papers.abstract_en: Image-source-method (ISM)-based room impulse response (RIR) simulation is a useful and physically interpretable tool for acoustic scene modeling, but full-order ISM becomes computationally expensive as the reflection order and room complexity increase. We propose a physics-guided framework for fast RIR simulation that preserves the geometric structure of ISM while learning to retain only acoustically important image-source paths during online traversal. To recover energy removed by pruning, the proposed PathRIR uses a lightweight compensation multilayer perceptron to predict the missing late-tail energy envelope and generate a compensation tail whose energy follows that envelope. Experiments on irregular 3D rooms show that PathRIR reduces image-source computation and improves runtime efficiency over a full-order ISM simulator, while achieving low waveform- and decay-related errors. Ablation results show that adding the compensation tail improves waveform fidelity and reduces energy-decay-curve error, reverberation-time error, and direct-to-reverberant-ratio error, with modest runtime overhead.
